en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a street procession or parade in a European city. Men in suits and hats march in front while a mixed group of men and women follow behind. Some participants carry large placards with Cyrillic text and a large flag. The street is lined with multi‑story buildings with shops and awnings, and crowds stand on the sidewalks watching the march.
